# Faglier's Mixed Martial Arts

> Family-run mixed martial arts gym in Augusta, Georgia offering MMA, Muay Thai,
> kickboxing and gi and no-gi Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu for kids and adults of all levels.
> The gym where UFC fighter Malcolm "The Machine" Wellmaker got his start.
> 2025 Best of Georgia Regional Winner.

## About
Faglier's Mixed Martial Arts (formerly Faglier's Kempo Karate School / FKKS) is a
family-owned and operated martial arts gym serving Augusta, Martinez, Evans and the wider
Central Savannah River Area (CSRA). Founded on Christian principles by Jason Faglier Sr.,
the gym has trained the Augusta community for more than twenty years, growing from a
traditional Kempo Karate school into a full mixed martial arts program. The gym emphasizes discipline, respect, confidence
and both physical and mental well-being for students of every age.

## What we train
- Kempo (the traditional martial art at the foundation of the gym; not currently scheduled as a standalone class)
- Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) — striking + grappling, recreational and competitive
- Muay Thai
- Kickboxing
- Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (gi and no-gi)
- Wrestling

- New students receive their first three classes free.
- Morning MMA — Monday & Wednesday, 6:30–7:30 AM

- Kids BJJ — ages 4–15, Tuesday & Thursday, 5:00–6:00 PM
- Kids MMA — ages 4–15, Friday, 5:00–6:00 PM
- No-Gi BJJ — Monday & Wednesday, 6:00–7:15 PM
- MMA — Monday & Wednesday, 7:15–8:30 PM
- BJJ — Tuesday & Thursday, 6:00–7:15 PM
- Muay Thai Kickboxing — Tuesday & Thursday, 7:15–8:30 PM
- Open Mat — all disciplines, Friday, 6:30–8:00 PM
- Competition Team Sparring — Saturday at 3:00 PM (invite only)
- Competition Team Conditioning — Sunday at 3:00 PM (invite only)

## Events
- October 17, 2026 — BIG NEWS: Faglier's coach Joel "The Sniper" Faglier makes his UFC debut, taking his undefeated 6–0 pro record into a heavyweight bout against Javad Mahjoub at UFC Fight Night: Buckley vs. Malott, Rogers Place, Edmonton, Alberta. Joel grew up in the family-run gym, wrestled at Cross Creek High School, went 8–0 as an amateur, and is 6–0 as a pro (2 TKOs, 3 submissions, 1 decision), most recently beating UFC veteran Cody East by unanimous decision at Fury FC 116. Profile: https://fightomic.com/joel-faglier-profile/ Announcement: https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1QaTLJVKhC/ — Event: https://www.ufc.com/event/ufc-fight-night-october-17-2026
- October 23, 2026 — Trunk or Treat family night hosted by Faglier's Mixed Martial Arts and Backyard Bullies Wrestling Club, 6:00–7:30 PM in the back parking lot at 266 Bobby Jones Expressway. Vehicle decorators can sign up at https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfXBHvTTMEhyWEIZjLvzv6HWnXRATORnJCAwmDi-KVvQwIBPw/viewform. Announcement: https://www.facebook.com/share/p/14jrKvo1GLG/

## Coaches
- Jason Faglier Sr. — coach; founded the gym in 1999; black belt in Chinese Kempo; black belt in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu; Muay Thai fighter and coach; former professional fighter; 3-time Sando champion
- Jason Faglier Jr. — coach; black belt in Jiu-Jitsu; current professional fighter
- Joel Faglier — coach; black belt in Chinese Kempo; black belt in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu; undefeated 6–0 professional heavyweight making his UFC debut on October 17, 2026; current USA Beach Wrestling World Team member; ASJL national champion; undefeated amateur record with 3 titles; NAIA national qualifier

## Starter gear
- Monthly memberships cover the scheduled program(s) selected; starter equipment is purchased separately.
- Kids karate gi: $45 (required starter equipment)
- Kids BJJ gi: $115 (required starter equipment)
- Adult BJJ gi: $160 (required starter equipment)

## Notable
- The gym where UFC bantamweight Malcolm "The Machine" Wellmaker got his start in mixed
  martial arts (he began here with no prior combat-sports experience before turning pro and
  reaching the UFC; he has since moved his primary pro training camp to a larger fight team).
- 2025 Best of Georgia Regional Winner — Martial Arts Training Facilities.
- 5.0 star rating across review platforms.
